claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord in types.ts has no 'magic_item' kind. The magic_item_root atom exists in v4 taxonomy but no MagicItemRecord type, no MagicItemMechanics family, and no tracer branch exist in the surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement) — You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_modifier_mechanics_family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's +1 AC and +1 to saving throws are always-on passive bonuses while worn. No mechanics family covers this shape: ongoing_effect and activation are spell/class-feature families; triggered_reaction requires a trigger; mastery requires a weapon hit. A 'passive_modifier' family is needed for items that apply stat modifiers unconditionally while attuned.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: attunement_mechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item requires attunement. The v4 atoms 'attune' (procedure) and 'attunement_slot' (resource) exist in the taxonomy but are absent from types.ts and the tracer.
